It is the only claim that directly measures the geometric near-orthogonality of v_c and v_v — the novel finding that no prior paper reports. C3a also has the cleanest integrity (PASS at Phase 2, no experiment or mechanism WARNs). Under single-model DIMENSIONS=model, this is the highest-value claim to stress-test under a cross-architecture swap.
